decision.title: Phase 1 work packets and conflict-free registration

body.p: (Phase 1 planning; is left to the CLI work, which cites it). Phase 1 is split into packets of one agent session (docs/tasks/phase-1.md) that run in parallel in one working tree. Each packet names the files it owns; packets that can run together own disjoint files. To make additions conflict-free, packet replaces the explicit lists with globs: src/*.c is the library and every tests/<name>_test.c is the ctest test <name>; tests/qt4/driver, tests/fuzz (with SXML_BUILD_FUZZERS) and third_party/mpdecimal join the build when their CMakeLists.txt exists. src/ stays flat; a module owns the prefix src/<module>[_<part>].c and src/<module>_internal.h. The ledgers (DECISIONS, GLOSSARY, LOG) take one small insertion per change, committed at once and alone; a D-number is claimed by re-reading the file first. Rejected: one subdirectory per module (breaks the module/header pairing of docs/C_GUIDELINES.md for little gain) and per-packet branches (the brief forbids branches).
